items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: With the band than they do with Nelson or anybody.

ctx.x: With the band than they do with Nelson or anybody. They have a different timbre in their voices. They just, you know that rhythm is incredible.
Yes. Well there’s a spark in the Basie band that the others don’t have.
